description: This file defines an authentication context in React, providing authentication state management (token and user) across the app. It includes an AuthProvider component that initializes authentication state from local storage or session storage, maintains backward compatibility, and exposes methods to update the auth state.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context, initializing state from local storage or session storage, and handles legacy session migration.

methods.name: genLegacyUser(parsed)
methods.description: Generates a new user object for legacy sessions, attempting to create or retrieve a user based on parsed legacy session data.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Updates the authentication token in state and syncs with session storage and local store.

methods.name: setUserPersist
methods.description: Updates the user state, persists it in local store and session storage, handling creation if needed.

methods.name: useAuth()
methods.description: Custom React hook to access authentication context.
